ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels, with approximately 95% of the visible surface presenting as high-intensity white.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field across the central and medial fluke surface. High-contrast dark pigmentation is restricted to the extreme distal tips (lateral margins) and a singular small, dark, roughly circular spot on the lower interior of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated divergence of approximately 70-80 degrees; vertical depth is roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire span; trailing edge is characterized by jagged peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 5 to 15 pixels, clearly delineated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, dark-brown and black irregular clusters localized at the far left and far right distal tips, indicating high-contrast pixel anomalies consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant dark pixel clusters and irregular protrusions at both lateral tips; small isolated dark spot on the lower right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellowish-brown organic growth or bio-fouling visible along the serrated peaks of the trailing edge.
